title: Sesinden anlar

characters.MOM: a mother in her sixties with short white hair and round glasses, wearing a teal knitted cardigan
characters.MAN: a young man of about twenty-nine with wavy dark hair, wearing a grey hoodie and a mustard scarf

scenes.prompt: On a rainy autumn night in a small city apartment, {MAN} sits alone on the floor against the sofa, a phone on speaker on the low table in front of him, tired eyes, dim lamp light.

scenes.text:
Çünkü yüzünü görmese de
sesindeki yorgunluğu duyar.
scenes.prompt: In a cozy living room far away, {MOM} sits in an armchair by a lamp, leaning toward a phone on the small table, listening carefully with a worried, tender face, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Çocukken ateşini alnından,
şimdi sesinden anlıyor.
scenes.prompt: In a child's bedroom long ago, lit by a small lamp, {MOM}, younger with dark hair, sits on the edge of the bed beside a sleeping little boy, watching over him, autumn rain outside.

scenes.text:
Kilometreler aranıza girdi,
ama onun kulağı hep sende.
scenes.prompt: A wide view at dusk of a long winding road through autumn hills, a small house with one warm window on one side and city lights far away on the other, soft rain.

scenes.text:
Bu akşam sadece iyi olduğun için ara.
Bunu annene gönder, sonra sesini duyur.
scenes.prompt: On a sunny autumn morning, {MAN} walks through a park full of golden leaves, smiling and talking on the phone, light and relaxed.

caption:
Gerçekten iyi misin?

Annen sesinden anlar, kandıramazsın. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder, sonra sesini duyur.
